name: rivout
description: River-channel discharge averaged over the output interval
notes: Binary gridded cells outside the model vector are filled with RMIS; NetCDF _FillValue is RMIS.

name: rivsto
description: River-channel storage at the output time
notes: P2RIVSTO is converted from JPRD to JPRB and then to the four-byte output kind.

name: rivdph
description: River-channel water depth at the output time

name: rivvel
description: Time-mean river flow velocity over the output interval

name: fldout
description: Floodplain outflow averaged over the output interval

name: fldsto
description: Floodplain storage at the output time
notes: P2FLDSTO is converted from JPRD to JPRB and then to the four-byte output kind.

name: flddph
description: Floodplain water depth at the output time

name: fldfrc
description: Fraction of the unit catchment classified as flooded at the output time
notes: Dimensionless fraction in [0,1]; NetCDF uses CF unit 1.

name: fldare
description: Flooded area within the unit catchment at the output time

name: sfcelv
description: Water-surface elevation at the output time

name: totout
description: Sum of river and floodplain outflow averaged over the output interval
notes: D2OUTFLW is the sum of river and floodplain outflow; bifurcation outflow is not added to this diagnostic.

name: outflw
description: Compatibility name for totout; same river-plus-floodplain discharge mean
notes: Legacy-compatible output name; it creates a separately named file with the same selected internal array as totout.

name: totsto
description: Combined river and floodplain storage at the output time
notes: When LLEVEE is enabled, cmf_ctrl_levee_mod adds protected-side storage P2LEVSTO to D2STORGE.

name: storge
description: Compatibility name for totsto; same combined storage snapshot
notes: Legacy-compatible output name; its total-storage value also includes P2LEVSTO when LLEVEE is active.

name: pthflw
description: Flow averaged over the output interval for each bifurcation channel and layer
source: cmf_ctrl_output_mod.F90 (CMF_OUTPUT_INIT/WRITE, CREATE_OUTBIN/CREATE_OUTCDF); cmf_ctrl_restart_mod.F90 (WRTE_REST_CDF dimension convention); cmf_calc_diag_mod.F90; yos_cmf_diag.F90; parkind1.F90
notes: Binary and NetCDF outputs use NPTHOUT by NPTHLEV records; NetCDF follows the pthflw_pre Restart dimension order, writes Float32 output-interval means, and uses standard output compression and time coordinates. The file also includes the static bifurcation table fields: pth_id, endpoint indices, source/outlet coordinates, length, elevation, depth, width, and ascending basin IDs. No missing-value sentinel is defined for the flow variable.

name: pthout
description: Net bifurcation discharge mapped to unit catchments and averaged over the output interval
notes: D2PTHOUT_aAVG is accumulated as bifurcation outflow minus bifurcation inflow before output-interval averaging.

name: maxsto
description: Maximum combined river and floodplain storage during the output interval
notes: Fortran long_name says daily maximum, but the accumulator resets at each output interval; the interval is controlled by IFRQ_OUT.

name: maxflw
description: Maximum absolute river-plus-floodplain discharge during the output interval
notes: The maximum accumulator applies ABS to total discharge. Fortran long_name says daily maximum, but the actual window is the IFRQ_OUT interval.

name: maxdph
description: Maximum river-channel depth during the output interval
notes: Fortran long_name says daily maximum, but the accumulator resets at each output interval; the interval is controlled by IFRQ_OUT.

name: runoff
description: Surface runoff rate delivered to river cells and averaged over the output interval

name: runoffsub
description: Subsurface runoff rate delivered to river cells and averaged over the output interval
notes: Output initialization rejects this variable when LROSPLIT is false.

name: damsto
description: Reservoir storage at the output time
notes: P2DAMSTO is converted from JPRD to JPRB and then to the four-byte output kind.

name: daminf
description: Reservoir inflow rate averaged over the output interval
notes: Underlying P2DAMINF is JPRD; the output-selected D2DAMINF_oAVG is JPRB and time averaged.

name: levsto
description: Water storage on the protected side of a levee at the output time
notes: P2LEVSTO is converted from JPRD to JPRB and then to the four-byte output kind.

name: levdph
description: Water depth on the protected side of a levee at the output time

name: gdwsto
description: Groundwater storage at the output time
notes: P2GDWSTO is converted from JPRD to JPRB and then to the four-byte output kind.

name: gwsto
description: Compatibility name for gdwsto; same groundwater storage snapshot
notes: Legacy-compatible name; the writer selects the same P2GDWSTO array as gdwsto.

name: gdwrtn
description: Groundwater return-flow rate averaged over the output interval

name: gwout
description: Compatibility name for gdwrtn; same groundwater return-flow mean
notes: Legacy-compatible name; the writer selects the same D2GDWRTN_oAVG array as gdwrtn.

name: wevap
description: Water evaporation extracted from the floodplain, averaged over the output interval
notes: The selected D2WEVAPEX field represents water evaporation extracted from the floodplain.

name: outins
description: Upstream-accumulated runoff diagnostic before river routing
notes: The field is computed from runoff and accumulated upstream before routed river discharge is calculated.

name: rofsfc
notes: Compatibility alias of runoff; long_name, units, time aggregation, and missing_value inherit via alias_of. The requested alias name is retained in the output file and NetCDF variable.

name: rofsub
notes: Compatibility alias of runoffsub; long_name, units, time aggregation, and missing_value inherit via alias_of; requires LROSPLIT.
